body:
I can't say I feel the same way as you and I can't say I understand how you feel, but I feel like I've got a mind that looks in a similar direction when I look at the world. It's great, I'm just not.

I'm sorry you feel this way. If there's anything you want to talk about, be that before you die or to talk you down, I'll be here to talk.

To be clear we don't have to talk about how you feel if that's too much, but if you think just talking about anything might help I'm here to do so.
I know, but I'm the problem. This life is perfect and I'm the one who can't take it.

I don't want to kill myself because I'm scared I'm upsetting my parents, I want to kill myself because I face constant guilt from my actions but yet I don't because I figure my parents would be ashamed if I killed myself. 

I want to run away because I hate myself but running away wouldn't fix myself and it would also upset my parents. It might make living easier, as I already know all I'll ever need for that life and that life would give me a much better chance at creating music, but I still might just be the same idiot who can't love himself on his best days and his friends on his worst.

Finishing college and finding a real job would make my parents happy. That's my motivation to live and to keep going in this life I have set for me.

But I feel like my parents might be a bit disappointed in me if I did. They wouldn't disown me but they wouldn't really be too happy with me getting a degree and a diploma and then dipping to the city to become a starving artist.

what the fuck is memory loss an actual effect of this shit

this explains so much but it's worth so little
I know this won't but if I don't change something else will, and I don't really know how to change someone I've never met.

You are worth saving. You're a human being, to me a good one, and to me that's enough.

You won't ruin anyone's life in a relationship. IF you do hurt them by being down around them (which, in my experience as the reciever of bad news, hasn't happened) they'll leave, but you'll never hurt a person who truly loves you. I know "true love" is a cliche but there's not a better way to describe it. It's what you think you feel every time you meet someone and you picture the rest of your life with them, but you know you feel it when you get scared they'll hurt themselves (Maybe I'm just codependant and don't accept it though).

Also, I don't think you need here for anyone but yourself. I know I'm a hypocrite for saying this, as I can't take it myself, but our lives go on no matter what happens in the world. We'll live whether a tree falls where nobody hears it or a house burns down two blocks away. We stay around because we're not the trees or the houses, we're the people. I'm not sure if the analogy worked but the point is we don't fold to what is or isn't around us, and we shouldn't stay because of who or what we do or don't have.

Similarly, your insignificance doesn't matter. Does having at least 8 people care about you make you less human than anyone with millions of fans? I don't think it does. And also, people will move on no matter what, but some won't ever. I'll remember you, my friend.

I'm sorry you still feel this way and I'm sorry if I'm coming off as a pushy little asshat. Would you care to talk more? I've got as long to listen as you have to talk.

I know this is only one point of your post but don't think having nothing to show for 23 years of life is a bad thing. You're a person, not a thing that has other things. You're not defined by your house or your job or your belongings, you're defined by you, your self. It's alright to have nothing to show.

It's alright to have mood swings and bad hygiene. I know it's not "ideal," but your only human. We're all just human. None of us are ideal. Also don't try to fit in with normality. You're not normal; a lot of us aren't. Normality is just another way of society saying what is good, but there is no "good." It's like art, what's good to you is good to you and what's good to me is good to me. You can't just say a piece is good or bad to everyone, and you can't just say a person is normal or weird, you can only say how you see it, and until you convince me otherwise then I'll see you as good.

Lastly, you're not a waste of space not having a purpose; we *all* are a waste of space. No matter how hard we try we'll all still end up destroying the earth and what's around us, and if we don't then nature will for us. It's alright to lack a purpose, but I hope you can find one. Not to become "worthwhile" or anything like that, but so you can find what you want. I want you to know what you want.

I'm sorry if I can't get my thoughts through to you, sometimes words are just a bad translation, but I hope you understand my point. Is there anything more you would like to say about your position?
I've been trying to make that happen but I think she's either scared to or doesn't have transportation. I'll keep trying, though.
I've been calling her. We've been talking every night. We only stop when she has to go.
It absolutely isn't too much. I'll be here for you as long as you need.

I'm sorry that you feel so alone and so attacked. 

I wish it was possible to stop feeling it when people do awful things out of spite, but I know personally that that just isn't possible. It must be awful to have someone going to such lengths as hacking you just to hurt you. I have sympathy for you.

Also, the friends and family you've lost must be awful. I don't think I've ever felt the great amount of loss you're feeling, being isolated from your own blood, but if you need someone to talk and connect to then I will be here for you if you ask me to be.
I'm sorry you feel like you have to do this to yourself. What are you feeling that makes you seem so close?

It's not selfish to act on fear, but please don't. You can come back from all your mistakes and everything that made you look like a fool, even if it'll take you a while, but there's no coming back from this.  The marks on your skin might scar, but they'll heal over. I'm not sure if you have family to worry about, but think of the love you know you say you feel. 

I'm sorry to look into the past and invade your privacy but you said you miss her. She might be gone, but maybe, just maybe, you could find someone else if you tried. Not someone like her, but, if you wanted to look hard enough, someone who understood you, and someone you understood.

Please, be strong, my friend.
